purpose: Correct canonical tree-digest metadata without changing original restoration records or payloads.
cause: The original PowerShell Sort-Object relative_path operation did not resolve OrderedDictionary keys as sort properties. Its unstable equal-key ordering is not canonical relative-path sorting. Original per-file hashes remain valid.
format: Paths relative to each tree root, using forward slashes; ascending StringComparer.Ordinal order; each record is relative_path + TAB + invariant decimal byte count + TAB + lowercase SHA-256. Encode as UTF-8 without BOM, join with LF, no trailing LF.
limits: Current destination-tree digests were recomputed from actual files and matched per-file manifest records. This correction does not repeat historical before/after observations or certify unrecorded streams, permissions, or intermediate edits. It supersedes only the original tree-level sorting claim and aggregate digests.
